One more, independent of the two above: #43906 feat(Analysis/Normed/Operator/Fredholm): compact perturbations of Fredholm operators.
Riesz–Schauder for a compact operator c on a Banach space over RCLike 𝕜: 1 + c is Fredholm of index 0
(IsCompactOperator.isFredholm_one_add, IsCompactOperator.index_one_add), hence u + k is Fredholm with
(u + k).index = u.index for u Fredholm and k compact — completing IsFredholm.add_hasFiniteRange.
Proof via the Fredholm alternative and a counting argument, no ascent/descent, no adjoint. LLM-assisted, checked by me.
